recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central square photographic window against a vast black field, topped with vibrant neon-pink cursive lettering. The central image depicts a macro view of a red rose with a single dewdrop, underscored by a horizontal sequence showing the blooming stages of a flower.
coreVisualRelationships: Central square image vs. expansive black negative space
Vibrant pink script vs. deep red floral tones
Macro focal point vs. sequential time-lapse footer
Soft organic floral textures vs. sharp geometric framing
coreInvariants: Square central frame with a thin white border
Neon pink script positioned in the upper third
Horizontal strip of sequential images at the bottom of the central frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A square photographic frame is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The macro red rose within the central square serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright pink script at the top, drop to the central macro rose, and then follow the sequential blooming strip from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central element, creating a sense of intimacy and focus.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Red and Coral (central image) providing warmth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neon Pink (typography) providing a modern, electric pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pink and red elements against a zero-value black background.

letterConstructionRules: Connected lowercase letters with expressive, elongated ascenders and descenders
Fluid, handwritten motion with slight irregularities
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase 'D' with a large open loop
Lowercase 'g' and 'y' with long, sweeping tails
Lowercase 'e' with a sharp, quick loop
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive script paired with a minimalist photographic layout.
graphicDevices: Thin white border around the central image
Sequential film-strip style layout for the bottom inset

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the quick, handwritten energy of the era.
Matches the vibrant, electric feel of the color and stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid black square canvas. In the center, place a square photograph with a thin white border. The photograph should be a macro shot of a red rose with a dewdrop. At the bottom of this square, include a horizontal strip of 6 small rectangular frames showing a rose bud gradually opening into a full bloom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of custom monolinear cursive text in neon pink across the top third of the black background. The handwriting should be fluid and expressive.

verificationChecks: Is the text color a vibrant neon pink?
Is the central image a square with a thin border?
Does the bottom of the square contain a sequential blooming animation strip?

adjustableVariables: Flower species in the central photo
Exact shade of the neon pink text
Number of frames in the sequential strip
mustRedesign: Record label logos or catalog numbers

mustAchieve: High contrast between black and neon/red

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is a single line and does not overlap the image.
Verify the white border around the square is thin and consistent.
Check that the sequential strip is perfectly aligned at the bottom of the square.
Confirm the black background is free of gradients or noise.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central square macro photo + sequential footer strip + top-aligned neon script + solid black void.
